name: CSG Smart Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: CSG Smart Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading Chinese enterprise dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and distribution of intelligent industrial solutions. Their comprehensive product portfolio spans multiple high-tech domains: Intelligent Grid and Communication Infrastructure: This includes 5G industrial wireless terminals, various distribution terminals and fault indicators, power consumption measurement devices, SF6 insulated network cabinets, column load switches, pole circuit breakers, and intelligent integrated switches. They also provide power quality enhancement products like active power filters, alongside diverse communication solutions such as optical line terminals, Beidou transmission terminals, and power line carriers. Smart Manufacturing and Logistics Systems: Their offerings feature MES (Manufacturing Execution System) management platforms, automated testing platforms, and intelligent warehousing solutions. Electric Vehicle Charging and Energy Storage: The company supplies a full range of charging piles, including wall-mounted, three-phase, and single-phase AC units, DC fast chargers, and integrated AC/DC charging systems, complemented by energy storage converters and interface devices. Advanced Robotics and Autonomous Systems: Their robotic solutions comprise traction, load, and forklift AGVs (Automated Guided Vehicles), often integrated with carriers, vision systems, or manipulators. They also develop wheeled and orbit inspection robots. Industrial Automation Equipment: This category includes multi-axis robots, power manipulators, pick-and-place systems, T-type robots, automated welding systems, specialized solutions for automotive parts, logistic system solutions, bespoke industrial intelligent equipment, and smart stackers. Hygiene Product Manufacturing Machinery: CSG also produces specialized machines for manufacturing disposable face masks, adult and baby diapers, sanitary napkins, panty liners, and under pads. These advanced solutions are implemented across a wide array of industries, such as aerospace, rail transit, automotive, electric power, construction machinery, consumer goods, and electrical equipment manufacturing. The company was founded in Shanghai, China, in 2002. It was originally known as Shanghai CSG Smart Science & Technology Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to CSG Smart Science & Technology Co., Ltd. in May 2012.
